name: Run suite2p pipeline

params.name: Raw Movie Files
params.description: Input 2P movie(s) [.isxd, .zip, .tif/.tiff, .ome.tif/.ome.tiff]

params.name: Optional Parameters File
params.description: Optional parameters file that allows for more granular control of all available suite2p parameters. See documentation for more details [.npy]

params.name: Optional Classifier File
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <classifier_path>] "Path to classifier file you want to use for cell classification." [.npy]

params.name: Overwrite Analysis Table Parameters
params.description: When a parameters file is provided as input, whether the parameters from the analysis table columns should be overwritten by the values from the file. Only effective when an optional parameters file is provided. Defaults to False. [bool]

params.name: Tau
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <tau>] "The timescale of the sensor (in seconds), used for deconvolution kernel. The kernel is fixed to have this decay and is not fit to the data. We recommend: 0.7 for GCaMP6f; 1.0 for GCaMP6m; 1.25-1.5 for GCaMP6s." [float, >=0.001]

params.name: Frames to Include
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <frames_include>] "If greater than zero, only [the first] <frames_include> frames are processed. Useful for testing parameters on a subset of data." Note that suite2p will not run on less than 50 frames, and might have unpredictable behavior on less than 200 frames [int, -1 or >=50]

params.name: Save NPY
params.description: If true, save suite2p NPY output (as a ZIP file) [bool]

params.name: Save ISXD
params.description: If true, save suite2p output as ISXD files [bool]

params.name: Save NWB
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <save_NWB>] "Whether to save output as NWB file." [bool]

params.name: Save MAT
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <save_mat>] "Whether to save the results in matlab format in file "Fall.mat"." [bool]

params.name: Maximum Registration Shift
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <maxregshift>] "The maximum shift as a fraction of the frame size. If the frame is Ly pixels x Lx pixels, then the maximum pixel shift in pixels will be max(Ly,Lx) * ops['maxregshift']." [float, [0.01 1]]

params.name: Threshold for Bad Frames
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <th_badframes>] "Involved with setting threshold for excluding frames for cropping. Set this smaller to exclude more frames." [float, >=0]

params.name: Nonrigid Registration
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <nonrigid>] "Whether or not to perform non-rigid registration, which splits the field of view into blocks and computes registration offsets in each block separately." [bool]

params.name: ROI Threshold Scaling
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <threshold_scaling>] "This controls the threshold at which to detect ROIs (how much the ROIs have to stand out from the noise to be detected). If you set this higher, then fewer ROIs will be detected, and if you set it lower, more ROIs will be detected." [float, >=0]

params.name: Neuropil Coefficient
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <neucoeff>] "Neuropil coefficient for all ROIs." [float, >=0]

params.name: Spikes Percentile Threshold
params.description: Threshold for denoising the deconvolved spike trains, in percentile. Any value in the ROIs-by-time-point deconvolved spike matrix that is below the matrix's xth percentile value is set to 0. Note that the same threshold is applied to all ROIs, and that this thresholding step does not binarize the deconvolved spike trains but simply filters out the low-amplitude spike events [float, [0 100)]

params.name: FOV vmin Percentile
params.description: Minimum value for the colormap range, as percentile of the FOV fluorescence [float, [0 <FOV vmax Percentile>)]

params.name: FOV vmax Percentile
params.description: Maximum value for the colormap range, as percentile of the FOV fluorescence [float, (<FOV vmin Percentile> 100]]

params.name: FOV Colormap
params.description: Colormap for plotting the FOV [str]

params.name: Show Grid on FOV
params.description: Whether or not to show the grid on FOVs [bool]

params.name: FOV Ticks Step
params.description: Step for the x- and y-ticks [int, >0]

params.name: Movie Display Rate
params.description: Display rate for the preview movies, in Hz [float, >=0.1]

params.name: Number of Sample Cells
params.description: Number of sample cells for the cell extraction preview [int, >0]

params.name: Random Seed
params.description: Random seed for selecting sample cells [int, >=0]

params.name: Show Non-Sample Cells' Footprints
params.description: Whether or not to show footprints of non-sample cells on the cell footprint FOV image. If False, only footprints of sample cells are displayed [bool]

description: Tool to run suite2p end-to-end on any format of 2p movie
